_about: Cut-offs used by app/pipeline.py. `confirm` is the Decisions API probability a model-proposed problem must reach to be reported; `detect` is the old detector-alone cut-off, kept for comparison. Untuned defaults until eval/tune.py sets them from dev-split photos by a rule fixed in advance. `quality` and `support` are untuned (0.5): no photos are labelled for evidence quality.
